overview: The Haryana State Start-ups Scheme is a flagship initiative of the Government of Haryana under the Department of Industries and Commerce, aimed at fostering innovation, entrepreneurship, and job creation by providing a comprehensive framework of fiscal and non-fiscal incentives to startups and incubators. It supports the creation of a vibrant startup ecosystem through financial assistance, regulatory simplifications, mentorship, incubation, and access to funding and networking opportunities. The scheme is aligned with the Haryana State Startup Policy 2022 and targets DPIIT-recognized startups operating within or through government-supported infrastructure in Haryana.
objectives: Create jobs and stimulate economic growth
Establish Haryana as a preferred destination for startups
Support 5000 startups in the next 5 years
Provide financial incentives including grants, subsidies, and tax benefits
eligibility: Company Age: Period of existence and operations should not exceed 10 years from the Date of Incorporation. Company Type: Incorporated as a Private Limited Company, Registered Partnership Firm, or Limited Liability Partnership. Annual Turnover: Should not exceed ₹100 crores for any financial year since incorporation. Original Entity: Should not have been formed by splitting up or reconstructing an existing business. Innovative & Scalable: Must work towards development or improvement of a product, process, or service with a scalable business model and high potential for wealth and employment creation. Category 1 Startups: Must be DPIIT-registered and have a registered office in Haryana. Category 2 Startups: Must be DPIIT-registered, have a registered office outside Haryana, but operate through government-owned or supported operational incubators located in Haryana.
benefits: Fiscal benefits include: Seed Grant up to INR 10 Lakh per startup; Lease Rental Subsidy (30% for general startups, 45% for women-led startups, max INR 5 Lakh for 1 year); Patent Cost Reimbursement (100% of actual expenses, max INR 25 Lakh); Reimbursement for Cloud Storage (75% of expenses, max INR 2.5 Lakh per annum for 5 years); Reimbursement for Acceleration Programs (up to INR 2.5 Lakh per year); Reimbursement of Net SGST (50% for 7 years, capped at 100% of Fixed Capital Investment). Non-monetary benefits: Relaxation in Public Procurement Norms, Subsidized Incubation Space, Access to Events/Workshops/Startup-Specific Programs, Mentorship, Networking with investors and industry experts, Access to funding and investment opportunities, Guidance from industry experts, and Simplified regulatory framework.
financial_support: Financial support is provided through multiple schemes: Seed Grant of up to INR 10 Lakh per startup for idea validation, prototype development, proof of concept, and initial activities; Lease Rental Subsidy of 30% (45% for women-led startups) of lease rental, max INR 5 Lakh for 1 year; Patent Cost Reimbursement of 100% of actual expenses (filing, consultancy, search, maintenance, publishing fees) up to INR 25 Lakh for domestic and international patents; Reimbursement for Cloud Storage at 75% of expenses, max INR 2.5 Lakh per annum for 5 years on Haryana-based Data Centres; Reimbursement for Acceleration Programs up to INR 2.5 Lakh per year; and Reimbursement of Net SGST at 50% for 7 years, capped at 100% of Fixed Capital Investment. All financial assistance is disbursed upon submission of required documents and approval by the Evaluation & Approval Committee.
application_process: 1. Register on the Startup Haryana portal at https://startupharyana.gov.in. 2. Log in using email/password, Gmail, or Startup India login details. 3. Select 'Startup' as the registration type. 4. Ensure DPIIT recognition is obtained prior to application (if not, get recognized via DPIIT first). 5. Complete the 4-step application form: (a) Details of the entity (Startup Details, Authorized Representative Details, Incubation Details, Upload Documents), (b) Details of Directors/Designated Partners, (c) Details of Business, (d) Preview and Final Submit. 6. Upload all required documents (file size ≤ 2 MB). 7. Accept terms and conditions and submit the application. 8. Application is processed within 30 days if no deficiencies; if deficiencies are found, applicant has 10 days to resubmit. 9. Upon approval, download the registration certificate from 'My Applications' section.
required_documents: Copy of Incorporation / Registration Certificate of entity
Copy of PAN & TAN Number of Entity
Copy of Memorandum of Association (MoA) and Articles of the Association (AoA) or Partnership Deed (as applicable)
Copy of the Balance Sheet of the Entity since Incorporation / Registration (if applicable)
Copy of DPIIT Certificate of Recognition as Startup
Aadhar Card & Passport size Colored Photograph of the Authorized Representative
Copy of ID Proof of each Director / Designated Partner/ Partner
Copy of Residential Proof of each Director / Designated Partner/ Partner
Copy of DIN/DPIN / Unique ID of Partners in case of Partnership Firm
Copy of PAN Card & Aadhar Card of each Director / Designated Partner/ Partner
Passport size Colored Photograph of the Director/ Designated Partner / Partner

Detailed Project Report w.r.t. product(s)/ process(s) / service(s) covering Description, Business Model, Features, Technology & Infrastructure Architecture, IPR, Innovativeness, scalability, potential employment etc.
deadlines: Rolling basis — no fixed deadline. Applications are accepted year-round.
implementing_agency: Department of Industries and Commerce, Government of Haryana

caveats: Benefits/Incentives can be availed under only one policy in the State (viz. Haryana State Startup Policy 2022 or HEEP 2020 or MSME or IT & ESDM Policy or any other State Policy).
All Government-owned/Supported Incubators in Haryana must register with Startup Haryana Cell under DITECH to be eligible for benefits.
Private incubators must have at least 10,000 Sq. ft. of built-up space, owned or leased, with lease period minimum 5 years if leased.
Seed Grant applications are evaluated quarterly; applications received in a quarter are considered in the subsequent quarter by the Evaluation & Approval Committee.
Lease Rental Subsidy is available for a maximum of 1 year only.
Patent Cost Reimbursement requires submission of CA-certified Utilization Certificate, invoices, tickets/boarding passes (if travel), and progress reports.
Cloud Storage Reimbursement is limited to Haryana-based Data Centres only.
Net SGST Reimbursement is capped at 100% of Fixed Capital Investment and available for 7 years.
